fact: The African Union Commission's status list dated 2 February 2026 records Tanzania (no. 50) with no date of signature, ratification or accession, and no deposit, for the Malabo Convention; the list totals 21 signatures and 20 ratifications among 55 states.

fact: Tanzania Leo, from the ICT ministry's press unit, reports that Parliament approved the resolution for Tanzania to accede to the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention); no deposit of the instrument is reported.
